theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : Monotone f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s ≤ f (insert a s) := by
  constructor
  · intro h_monotone
    intros s a h_not_in
    have : s ⊆ insert a s := by simp [insert_subset]
    have : f s ≤ f (insert a s) := h_monotone s (insert a s) (subset_insert s a) 
  · intro h_insert
    intros s t h_subset
    have : s ⊆ t := h_subset
    induction t using Finset.induction with t' a ht' ha ht,
    case Finset.empty => 
      exact le_refl (f ∅)
    case Finset.insert => 
      have : f s ≤ f t := by
        have : s ⊆ t := h_subset
        have : t = insert a t' := by simp
        have : s ⊆ t' := by simp [h_subset]
        have : f s ≤ f t' := by apply ht'
        have : f t' ≤ f t := by apply h_insert _ _ (not_mem_insert _ _ (not_mem_iff.2 (ht' a)))
        exact le_trans this this
      exact this
